title.zh: 修订第1965号共和国法第1条与第2条中关于 Bataan 农业中学选址的内容的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Sections One and Two of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Sixty-Five Relative to the Site of the Bataan Agricultural High School
title.orig: An Act Amending Sections One and Two of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Sixty-Five Relative to the Site of the Bataan Agricultural High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2438_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Sections one and two of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred sixty-five are hereby amended to read as follows:
Sec. 1 . There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Public Schools, an agricultural high school in the Municipality of Dinalupihan, Province of Bataan, at a suitable site to be selected by said Director, to be known as the Bataan Agricultural High School.
Sec. 2 . Upon the recommendation of the Director of Public Schools, the President shall set aside and reserve such portion of the public lands located within the Municipality of Dinalupihan of said province, as may be necessary and convenient for the establishment of the said school and of its farm site."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
